language.description: Language for syntax highlighting (e.g. `html`, `js`). Unset renders plain, uncoloured text.

variant.description: Visual treatment of the code span or block — controls the surface it is drawn on.

scrollable.description: When `"true"`, scroll horizontally rather than wrapping long lines.

size.description: Type scale for the code text: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Defaults to `md`.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
